PRIMARY_ENDPOINT: paired post-intervention duration of the same locked daughter identity
SIGN_CONVENTION: SELECTIVE minus SHAM, on the paired log difference
PAIRED_TEST: two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank with Pratt ranking; the conditional sign-flip distribution is enumerated by dynamic programming. No normal approximation anywhere.
SUPPORT_REQUIRES: both median effects have the same sign

MATCHED_DESIGN.unit: the base block — one seed, one trigger, both arms
MATCHED_DESIGN.time_origin: t_m, the frozen trigger step, identical in both arms by construction
procedure: one common prefix to the frozen functional-maturity time t_m
record complete physical and RNG state

ACCRUAL_RULE: process the frozen base seeds in index order until 41 technically valid admissible pairs are retained, or the hard 512-arm-instance ceiling is exhausted. A base seed without an admissible trigger consumes its predeclared cost and is never selectively replaced. A technical retry uses the identical seed and arm. A scientific non-trigger consumes its seed.
ONE_ARM_INSTANCE: one full-horizon world-equivalent of engine work, T = 11000 steps
PREFIX_TRUNCATION: the common prefix runs only to the frozen LATEST_ALLOWED_TRIGGER = 6500, because a maturation candidate after that step fails the frozen deadline gate. This uses the frozen rule and changes no definition.
SEED_DERIVATION: seed(role, index, nonce) = the first 4 bytes, big-endian, of sha256('<OMLDCT01 invalid-closure tip>|OMLDCT02|<law string>|<role>|<index>' and, only when a nonce is needed, '|<nonce>'), interpreted as an unsigned 32-bit integer. nonce starts at 0 and increments only when the candidate collides with an already-accepted OMLDCT02 seed or with the forbidden set. Every nonce actually used is recorded, so the whole list is recomputable from this file alone.
METHODS_CLOSURE_NOTE: the UNION. A superset closure can only over-bind and can never leave an executing file unhashed. The disagreement is reported, not trimmed away.

SCIPY.BY_WHICH_FILE: /FMRT01/code/fmrt01_endpoint.py, at module level: 'from scipy.stats import binom'
SCIPY.WHY_IT_IS_THERE: the frozen engine tlmr01_world imports fmrt01_endpoint for state_of, local_x_masses and f5_ratio. None of those three uses scipy.
SCIPY.THE_ONLY_SCIPY_CALL_IN_THAT_FILE: binom.ppf inside survivor_upper(), which is on no OMLDCT02 path and is never called by this mission.
SCIPY.THE_EXACT_TEST: the conditional sign-flip distribution is enumerated by dynamic programming; omldct02_analysis imports fractions and numpy, and importing it alone does not pull scipy into the process.
SCIPY.A_CORRECTION: OMLDCT01's methods closure recorded 'scipy: not imported anywhere'. That was false as stated — scipy has been in the process since the engine was written. Corrected here rather than repeated, and a runtime sentinel in the batch runner records whether binom.ppf is ever actually called.

PRE_RUN_DISCLOSURES.the_finding: OMLDCT01's disclosed 0.5063 is reproduced here at 474 seeds and is therefore correct — but it measures the wrong constraint. It is the probability of reaching 41 pairs before the SEED LIST runs out, not before the frozen 512-instance ceiling does. With the ceiling alone the probability is essentially 1 and the largest number of seeds any simulated campaign consumed was 789.

PRE_C2_SCIENTIFIC_SCALE_GUARD.rule: L > 5, or horizon >= NEED = 250, or a seed in this manifest, makes a construction scientific-scale and requires a committed C2

CLAIM_CEILING: a positive result establishes at most that, under one frozen law, selective removal of the parent changed both the post-removal identity duration and the particle-step exposure of the same locked daughter relative to a bit-identical sham, with concordant effect direction.

HASH_LABELS.FREEZE_CONTENT_HASH: canonical digest of the master freeze document with FREEZE_CONTENT_HASH and GENERATED_UTC removed. Answers: is the frozen CONTENT this content?
HASH_LABELS.FREEZE_FILE_SHA256: sha256 of the master freeze FILE's bytes on disk. Answers: is this FILE byte-identical? Stored OUTSIDE the freeze, in its sidecar and in the external manifest, because a file cannot contain its own file digest.
HASH_LABELS.METHODS_HASH: canonical digest of the ordered [path, sha256] list of every method file.
HASH_LABELS.SEED_SET_HASH: canonical digest of the ordered [role, index, seed] list of every seed.

CANONICAL_RULES.algorithm: SHA-256, output as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
CANONICAL_RULES.sort_keys: true — object keys are ordered by Unicode code point, so insertion order cannot change a digest
CANONICAL_RULES.whitespace_rule: the encoded JSON contains no whitespace outside string literals
CANONICAL_RULES.newline_rule: NO trailing newline. The digest is taken over the encoded bytes exactly as produced by json.dumps, with nothing appended
CANONICAL_RULES.text_encoding: UTF-8. ensure_ascii=True means the encoded form is pure ASCII, so the UTF-8 step cannot introduce a platform difference
CANONICAL_RULES.float_rule: no float is ever hashed. Law parameters enter a digest by their IEEE-754 bit pattern as a lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal string, never by their decimal repr, which is where two Python versions could disagree
CANONICAL_RULES.path_ordering: byte-lexicographic ordering of the UTF-8 encoding of the repository-relative POSIX path. Every path begins with '/' and uses '/' as separator on every platform
CANONICAL_RULES.list_ordering: lists are hashed in the order given and that order is stated by the caller. No digest depends on a set iteration order
CANONICAL_RULES.excluded_self_referential_fields: a document's own digest field is removed before the document is hashed, and so is GENERATED_UTC, so that regenerating an unchanged document reproduces its digest exactly
